scripts.prepare-backend: cd backend && composer install && php artisan key:generate && php artisan migrate --force && php artisan config:clear && php artisan cache:clear
scripts.setup: npm run prepare-backend && npm run prepare-frontend && npm run prepare-api
scripts.start: npm run setup && concurrently "cd backend && php artisan serve --port=8000" "cd frontend && npm run dev -- --port 5173" "cd api && python app.py"
